title: Control Plane: Auth Brute Force
description: Repeated authentication failures or rate-limit rejections (401/429) against /api/auth/* from a single client IP — indicates credential stuffing or login brute force. Correlates with the SEC-6 perimeter rate limiter.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Control Plane Access Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Control Plane Access Logs') and ('URI Path' like '/api/auth/%') and ('Status Code' = 401 or 'Status Code' = 429) | stats count as attempts by 'Source IP' | where attempts > 10
falsepositives: A legitimate operator mistyping the token repeatedly
Automated health probes hitting auth endpoints
